title: 1/4" Female Quick Disconnect Fuel Adapter
lead: MOC has developed a new 1/4in female fuel adapter. This new Quick Disconnect adapter (Part No. 73063) is deeper allowing it to connect to fuel systems with longer stems.
body: This adapter has been confirmed to fit the newer Toyota vehicles.
